lines.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by God's will, writes to Timothy, his beloved child.
Timothy's sincere faith first dwelt in Lois and Eunice, and Paul tells him to fan God's gift into flame.
God gave us a spirit of power, love, and self-control, so Timothy should not be ashamed of the Lord's testimony.
God saved us by His own purpose and grace, and Christ Jesus abolished war.
Everyone in Asia deserted Paul, but Onesiphorus searched diligently until he found Paul in Corinth.
